parent_objective: implement and smoke-test expanded no-policy source generator profiles
blocked_by: M1316 admits selectable source generator profiles before corpus materialization
supersedes: using the M1273/M1280 narrow source-history corpus for more objective tuning

public_gates: M1317 must not use private holdout
M1317 must preserve actor input contract
M1317 must keep strict source acceptance thresholds
M1317 must export accepted and inactive family diagnostics
M1317 must report coverage gaps rather than accepting fake labels
forbidden_shortcuts: do not relax source acceptance thresholds
do not claim high-fidelity tire blowout or drivetrain validation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether expanded no-policy source generator profiles can create broader accepted source-family coverage
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-generation infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if source profiles require actor input expansion
stop if accepted thresholds must be relaxed
stop if new families are labels without dynamics
stop if no new family passes strict source acceptance
fallback_plan: if enough families pass, route to updated source corpus export
if only some families pass, route to family-specific generator repair
if dynamics cannot express the missing families, route to simulator extension design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1316 design admits one bounded source-generation smoke

admission_evidence: M1315 reported only 108 source pairs and 3 source families
M1316 designs supported generator updates and blocked high-fidelity claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1317 is no-policy source generation and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: generate richer matched command-response source pairs for later history materialization
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1316 source generator update design and M1315 coverage gaps.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If a family cannot create strict action divergence, export it as inactive or undercovered rather than accepting it.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: Selectable expanded fault, scenario, and action profiles can produce broader strict no-policy source coverage without actor-input expansion or threshold relaxation.
success_criteria: accepted_separable_pairs >= 160 or explicit coverage gaps are reported
accepted_fault_family_pairs >= 5 or explicit family blockers are reported
strict source acceptance thresholds are preserved
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: new families are relabeled without dynamics
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs

commands.name: focused_tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_four_wheel_fault_source_shape.py tests/test_four_wheel_dynamics.py

commands.name: source_generation_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.four_wheel_fault_source_shape --fault-profile source_expansion_v1 --scenario-profile source_expansion_v1 --action-profile mixed_emergency_v1 --run-dir runs/m1317_source_generator_update_smoke

decision_rule: M1317 passes as infrastructure if it implements and smoke-tests expanded no-policy source profiles with strict acceptance thresholds, exported inactive-family diagnostics, and no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, fake labels, or actor-input expansion.
